reviews.review_description:
Cone Runners is an okay game overall, but it has some issues. Since the game has just released, things may change in the future.

As of writing this review, there are 8 GameModes: Hangout, Zero Gravity, Cookie Clicker, Museum, PVP, Find The Button, Caves, and Flash Flood. Most are decent, but some have flaws. Cookie Clicker gets repetitive quickly, with little incentive beyond earning a collectible after 2,500 clicks. Museum doesn't really feel like a gamemode and could have been included elsewhere. PVP and Flash Flood are probably the most replayable, especially Flash Flood since it rewards currency.

Overall, I don't see much reason to keep coming back to most gamemodes, as they offer few rewards or incentives to keep playing.

My biggest issue is the lack of things that motivate players to continue playing beyond interacting with the community. Earning currency is difficult because the only options are waiting a day or playing Flash Flood, which only rewards 10 currency and requires restarting the game to earn more.

Realms are a decent addition, but they could be better executed. A staff member selects an entity and teleports everyone in the server into a Realm. Players must survive until the timer runs out to escape.

The concept is interesting, but surviving is extremely difficult. You either have to outrun the entity, which is hard due to its speed boost, or hide and hope it doesn't find you in the relatively small map. You also can't fight back, or defend yourself.

So, would I recommend Cone Runners? It depends on what you're looking for. The game has flaws and bugs, but it isn't terrible, and since it just released, improvements may come.

Overall, I think Cone Runners has potential, but in its current state, it feels lacking in replayability and rewards.

developer_response.body: I took note to this and changes have been made. I am still trying to find out how to make a fightback system for entities with entity HP and stun weapons.
